teams.name: Netherlands Antilles
teams.description: A former Caribbean territory within the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Its delegation remains separate from its successor territories.
teams.identityHint: A former Dutch Caribbean territory that included Curaçao.

teams.identityHint: Its capital is Andorra la Vella.

teams.name: Australasia
teams.description: Australia and New Zealand competed as a combined Olympic delegation in 1908 and 1912.
teams.identityHint: Australia and New Zealand shared this Olympic team.

teams.name: Bohemia
teams.description: Bohemia competed separately while part of Austria-Hungary. The region is now part of Czechia.
teams.identityHint: Prague was the centre of this historical region, now part of Czechia.

teams.name: United Team of Germany
teams.description: East and West Germany competed together at the Summer and Winter Olympics in 1956, 1960 and 1964.
teams.identityHint: East and West Germany came together under one sporting banner.

teams.name: Unified Team
teams.description: A combined delegation of former Soviet republics at the 1992 Games, following the dissolution of the USSR.
teams.identityHint: Former Soviet republics competed together under this name in 1992.

teams.name: West Germany
teams.description: The West German delegation is kept separate from East Germany and reunified Germany. Olympic 1952 results retain Olympedia’s Germany identity.
teams.identityHint: Bonn was the capital of this former western German state.

teams.name: East Germany
teams.description: The German Democratic Republic competed separately from West Germany before German reunification in 1990.
teams.identityHint: This former German state lay east of the Iron Curtain.

teams.name: Germany
teams.description: Germany’s medals here exclude the combined East–West team of 1956–1964, East Germany and West Germany. The 1952 Olympic delegation retains Olympedia’s Germany attribution.

teams.identityHint: This historical delegation came from the territory now known as Zimbabwe.

teams.name: Russian Empire
teams.description: The pre-revolutionary Russian Empire is kept separate from the Soviet Union and the modern Russian delegation.
teams.identityHint: This imperial team competed before the Russian Revolution of 1917.

teams.identityHint: Its two successor countries are Czechia and Slovakia.

teams.name: United Arab Republic
teams.description: Egypt competed under the United Arab Republic name, including after its political union with Syria ended. These results remain separate from Egypt’s other editions.
teams.identityHint: Egypt competed under this name after forming a union with Syria.

teams.name: Soviet Union
teams.description: A former union of 15 republics, including Russia and Ukraine. Its medals remain separate from its successor teams.
teams.identityHint: This former union included Russia, Ukraine and 13 other republics.

teams.name: West Indies Federation
teams.description: This Olympic delegation represented the short-lived West Indies Federation, with athletes from Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, and Barbados.
teams.identityHint: Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, and Barbados supplied this combined Caribbean team.

teams.name: Yugoslavia
teams.description: The historical Yugoslav delegation is preserved separately from the later Serbia and Montenegro delegation and today’s successor countries.
teams.identityHint: A former Balkan federation whose republics included Serbia, Croatia and Slovenia.
